faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 10 November 2026, and candidates report at 2:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for Ground maintenance personnel.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 10 November 2026 at 2:00 PM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: VC's Conference Hall, Mahatma Gandhi University headquarters.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 50 years. Relaxation: SC/ST and other reserved categories As per existing Government/University rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 525 per day (daily wage).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 8th class; work experience desirable.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Working hours: Monday to Friday, 9 am to 5 pm.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview. Interview held on 10.11.2026 at 02.00 pm in the VC's Conference Hall.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment on daily wage basis.
